verdict.rationale: Weave documents offline evaluations on test datasets and a Playground for prompt and model experiments. Neither is a sandbox environment isolated from production data, and no evidence describes separate sandbox or staging projects or data isolation. The site promotes testing models against production traces and letting coding agents read live production data, which runs opposite to the story. Evaluations and Playground are adjacent features, not the named capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
